rev.t: Today, we took delivery of our Royal Enfield Guerrilla 450 from Teknik Motors, Indiranagar. It was a wonderful experience from start to finish. …

Really appreciate the way the team stepped up and ensured everything was completed properly. They arranged all the pending accessories, including sourcing the clutch guard quickly, and got everything installed the same day. …

Extremely disappointing experience with Teknik Motors. I went to the dealership to take delivery of my brand new bike, and during the delivery inspection, I noticed a scratch on the fuel tank. It is unacceptable to find damage on a bike …
